description: This file declares the HealthcheckServiceFactory class, which implements the IHealthcheckServiceFactory interface. It provides a factory method to create health check service instances and holds a configuration parameter for health check interval.

classes.name: HealthcheckServiceFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating health check service instances, configured with a health check interval.

methods.name: HealthcheckServiceFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with a specified health check interval.

methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of a health check service.
